plain_english: Whole garland, sequenceless, in self again entered — endless-inner-massed-great-ray-heaped. Supreme, divine-bliss to grasp, noble-eager, gracious to me may she be — heart-path let her adorn.
sanskrit_cite: samagrām akṣālīṃ kramavirahitā sātmani muhur | prasannā me bhūyāt hṛdayapadavīṃ bhūṣayatu ca
